verdict.rationale: GrowthBook ships its own scheduled automation in a narrow area. Rules can be scheduled, and a release plan or ramp schedule increases a rollout automatically over time without manual steps; stale-flag detection also runs automatically. There is no general-purpose automation builder, and the toggle endpoint called from a deploy script is a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a general automation or workflow builder with arbitrary triggers and actions, recurring background jobs beyond rollout ramping, agent-driven autonomous tasks, and independent or hands-on confirmation that ramp schedules run unattended.
